I tested 5 properties on `soupsieve.css_parser` (soupsieve 2.9). Two passed and three found reproducible bugs. I wrote a report for each bug, with a standalone repro and a proposed patch. | # | Bug | Type / Severity | Report | |---|-----|-----------------|--------| | 1 | **Deep nesting crashes with `RecursionError`.** `sv.compile('div' + ':is('*400 + 'div' + ')'*400)` raises an uncaught `RecursionError` instead of a `SelectorSyntaxError`. The 8192 limit is described as a "nesting limit", but it counts selector parts, not how deep they nest. Each level of nesting uses about 3 Python stack frames, so Python's recursion limit is hit at around 330 levels, before the guard fires. A user-supplied selector of about 2 KB can crash an app that only catches soupsieve's own errors. | Crash / Medium | `bug_report_soupsieve_css_parser_2026-10-06_01-16_dnfb.md` | | 2 | **`:-soup-contains()` unescapes its argument twice.** `"a\\b"` turns into `a\x0b`, so you can't search for a literal backslash. `"x\"y"` gets split into two values, `x` and `y`, so it matches `

x

` by mistake. `:lang()` uses the same syntax and handles it correctly. | Logic / Medium | `bug_report_soupsieve_css_parser_2026-10-06_01-16_wz48.md` | | 3 | **`escape()` output can't be parsed for U+0080–U+009F.** `escape()` leaves these characters as they are, but the parser's identifier pattern rejects them. So `sv.compile('#' + sv.escape('\x80'))` raises `SelectorSyntaxError`. | Contract / Low | `bug_report_soupsieve_css_parser_2026-10-06_01-16_0zoi.md` | The two tests that passed: - `css_unescape(escape(s)) == s` for any string without NUL. - An attribute selector whose value is fully hex-escaped matches the element it was built from. For bug 2, I tried the one-line fix (drop the first `css_unescape`) as a patch applied in memory only. With it, `"a\\b"` and `"x\"y"` match the right elements, and a list with several values still works. I didn't run the fixes for bugs 1 and 3. They're sketches, and the bug 1 patch is only outlined, not ready to apply. I didn't modify the soupsieve checkout itself. The tests and the three reports are in `runs/soupsieve_r3/`; the tests are in `test_css_parser.py`.
